maintainer.contact: Repository issue / PR tagged app:northlake-portal (environment PR #14, @ZichenYuan)

capabilities.ui: business web app (pale.web) plus reviewer renderer

limitations: One patient per instance: no proxy, family or sibling-chart access.
Notices to Mail are built and published by the host-run publisher after a commit; the App never observes delivery outcomes and records no notice status.
Documents can be attached only to messages; statements and thread exports are generated bytes, not stored assets.
Nothing fires when the clock moves: reminders, statement runs and staff replies are events the task applies through Infra.
